image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a pelican (likely an Australian Pelican or similar species) floating on green water. The bird has white plumage on its head and neck, transitioning to black and grey mottled feathers on its back and wings. It features a very long, pale pinkish bill with a large gular pouch. The background is a smooth, out-of-focus teal/green water surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bill is significantly longer than the head. The coloration is a pale pink/flesh tone, consistent with many pelican species.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head proportions are consistent with a large waterbird, and the pouch is visually dominant.

The background is uniformly smooth, lacking natural water texture variation. This is likely intentional depth-of-field simulation but borders on artificial smoothing.
